lines.t: intro
(soft acoustic guitar, low piano, distant wind)
Hear The Word, o restless earth
you’re sinking fast, forgetting worth
hands of dust, hearts of stone
you built a world but lost your home
verse 1
lost at sea in shifting sand
trusting works of mortal hands
knowledge high, yet wisdom thin
religion dressed in robes of sin
the garden burns by greedy flame
the fruit returns, it speaks your name
what you sow now circles back
life grows weak, the way grows cracked
pre‑chorus
darkness gathers wing and claw
yet no one trembles, no one draws
near the truth that cries aloud
while wolves wear white and stalk the crowd
chorus
tremble, heavens earth, awake
the ground will move, the mountains shake
bow the knee, the hour has come
the King descends, the will be done
tremble, nations hear the sound
the lost are called, the proud brought down
mercy stands, but time is thin
choose the light or choose the end
verse 2
shepherds feed on flock and fame
building thrones in heaven’s name
they guard their halls, neglect the sheep
and trade the truth they swore to keep
the houses fall, foundations crack
dust and sorrow pile in stacks
love was given, blood was paid
yet still the call is pushed away
pre‑chorus 2
still the voice of mercy cries
before the storm splits open skies
return, return today is near
salvation knocks, the door is here
chorus
tremble, heavens earth, awake
the ground will move, the mountains shake
bow the knee, the hour has come
the King descends, the will be done
tremble, nations hear the sound
the lost are called, the proud brought down
mercy stands, but time is thin
choose the light or choose the end
bridge
watch the fig tree, leaves are green
the signs are loud, the space between
what once was sealed is opening wide
what stood in shadow steps to light
a shout will tear the silent air
the faithful rise, the wicked fear
no metaphor, no empty word
every line fulfilled, every truth heard
final chorus
bow before the Holy One
the Rock, the Shield, Salvation’s Son
lay your life upon the stone
be lifted up or overthrown
bow before the King who comes
The Alpha, end, The Living One
He does not change, His Word stands true
the choice is now it rests with you
outro
(violin and piano fade, deep male narrator)
lay down your pride, return, be still
for Heaven moves at the Father’s will
the King is near…
and mercy yet remains
